title: Command menu in dialog
description: Wrap Command in a dialog for Cmd+K.
code:
import * as React from "react"
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTrigger } from "@/components/ui/dialog"
import { Command, CommandInput, CommandList, CommandItem } from "@/components/ui/command"

export function CommandPalette() {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false)
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogTrigger className="rounded border px-3 py-2 text-sm">Cmd+K</DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent className="p-0">
        <Command>
          <CommandInput placeholder="Type a command…" />
          <CommandList>
            <CommandItem>Go to billing</CommandItem>
            <CommandItem>Open changelog</CommandItem>
          </CommandList>
        </Command>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  )
}

title: Select in a form
code:
import * as React from "react"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select"

export function SelectPlan() {
  const [plan, setPlan] = React.useState<string | undefined>()
  return (
    <form className="flex items-center gap-2" onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
      <Select value={plan} onValueChange={setPlan}>
        <SelectTrigger className="w-56"><SelectValue placeholder="Choose plan" /></SelectTrigger>
        <SelectContent>
          <SelectItem value="starter">Starter</SelectItem>
          <SelectItem value="pro">Pro</SelectItem>
          <SelectItem value="team">Team</SelectItem>
        </SelectContent>
      </Select>
      <Button disabled={!plan}>Continue</Button>
    </form>
  )
}

import * as React from "react"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from "@/components/ui/popover"

export function PopoverDate() {
  const [date, setDate] = React.useState("2026-06-14")

    <Popover>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant="secondary">Pick date</Button>
      </PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent className="w-72">
        <label className="text-sm">Date</label>

      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  )
}
